body: Never refresh, copy, write or print a vendor CLI's own stored OAuth login (Claude keychain / .credentials.json, Codex auth.json). Refreshing rotates the refresh token and logs the vendor CLI out; an expired login is reported with the command that makes the vendor CLI refresh it (AGX-002, 2026-09-24). Narrowed 2026-10-16 for logins (LOGINS_SPEC D5): long-lived tokens the user gives agx (Claude setup-tokens, API keys) may be stored only in ~/.agx/tokens.yaml (0600, 0700 dir) or read from the user's own token_cmd / token_env, are set only in the child env, and never appear in any output (login ls, --dry-run, --json, errors, launch line). A no-leak test sweeps every command for a known token value.
